name: Zvec
description: Embeds an in-process vector database into applications for dense, sparse, full-text, and hybrid search with durable local storage, via Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, and Dart SDKs.

skills.name: Dense And Sparse Vectors
skills.description: Stores dense and sparse embeddings with multi-vector queries and a choice of index types that scale from in-memory to on-disk.

skills.name: Full-Text Search
skills.description: Queries string fields with natural-language or structured keyword expressions, including an N-gram tokenizer for phrase and code search.

skills.name: Hybrid Search
skills.description: Combines vector similarity, full-text search, and structured filters in a single query to narrow results to the precise matches.

skills.name: Durable Local Storage
skills.description: Persists collections with write-ahead logging so data survives crashes, and lets multiple processes read one collection at once.
